usedFor: Shopify holds orders and checkouts, and BigMailer receives the customers through “Add/Update Contact”, ready for email.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Add/Update Contact” in BigMailer
bestTemplate.why: It puts shoppers who left at checkout into a BigMailer brand so they can be emailed.

watchOut: Because “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, a left cart reaches BigMailer after a scheduled check.
